note: 313.events owner photo library for the seasonal collections. DESTINATION_SPECIFIC photos show a confirmed destination. EDITORIAL_ATMOSPHERIC photos illustrate a seasonal experience and must never be labelled as a specific destination. No GPS or EXIF is stored here or in the image files; originals stay outside the repo.

classifications.DESTINATION_SPECIFIC: Depicts a confirmed destination; may be used on that destination card and elsewhere with accurate attribution.
classifications.EDITORIAL_ATMOSPHERIC: Illustrates a seasonal experience without claiming a specific destination; reusable across editorial contexts.
